description: Schema-neutral D09 research evidence. This file is not a parser, profile, or fixture contract.

stateVocabulary.documented: Affirmatively stated by current first-party documentation.
stateVocabulary.source-derived: Established by the pinned official implementation or tests but not promised by documentation.
stateVocabulary.observed: Produced by a pinned executable in an isolated local probe.
stateVocabulary.conditional: Depends on trust, roots, settings, event, or mode.
stateVocabulary.contradiction: Current first-party documentation and pinned source disagree.
stateVocabulary.unknown: Not defined precisely enough for a deterministic compatibility claim.
stateVocabulary.blocked-paid-observation: No guaranteed local-only inspection path exists and testing may require an authenticated or model-backed session.

facts.claim: The default global context file is GEMINI.md under the user Gemini directory and global context precedes workspace context.
For each trusted root, startup discovery walks upward to the nearest configured boundary marker, includes the marker directory, and stops there; without a marker it stops at the trusted root.
An empty memoryBoundaryMarkers array disables parent traversal.
Project candidates across roots are deduplicated by followed file identity and finally sorted lexicographically by absolute path.
Untrusted workspaces suppress workspace and JIT memory, and their workspace settings are excluded from the persistent settings merge.
Pinned source does not eagerly recurse below workspace roots, while the current configuration reference describes eager descendant scanning capped at 200 directories.
A high-intent file or directory tool access triggers descendant-context discovery.
JIT selects the deepest trusted root containing the target and returns no context for a target outside every trusted root.
JIT context is ordered from boundary ceiling to target directory and excludes file identities already loaded in the session.
JIT discovery errors are swallowed and do not fail the primary tool operation.
context.fileName accepts a string or string list; the default context filename is GEMINI.md.
Configured non-empty normalized names are prepended in first-occurrence order and the existing default is retained unless duplicated.
Wrong types generate validation warnings but malformed expanded settings are still returned; downstream coercion is not a compatibility promise.
Documentation describes a filename but source does not expose a clear containment contract for separator, absolute, or traversal-like values.
Persistent scalar settings precedence is schema defaults, system defaults, user, trusted workspace, then system override.
includeDirectories concatenates across settings layers, is resolved relative to cwd, and is followed by CLI include-directory arguments.
Documentation says the flag controls roots scanned by memory reload, while manager refresh scans initialized workspace roots and the flag gates refresh after dynamic directory addition.
discoveryMaxDirs defaults to 200 but has no effect in the reviewed ancestor/JIT source path; older current documentation assigns it an eager descendant-scan limit.

The historical proposed spelling context.loadFromIncludeDirectories is absent from the pinned schema, documentation, and implementation and is not a current alias for context.loadMemoryFromIncludeDirectories.
Gemini settings permit environment-variable interpolation, but normal linter analysis must preserve placeholders as inert untrusted text and must not inspect or expand ambient environment values.
.geminiignore supports gitignore-like blank lines, comments, globs, directory suffixes, root anchors, and negation; changes require restart.
With all families active, precedence is .gitignore then .geminiignore then custom; earlier custom files have higher priority than later custom files.
Ignore filters apply to supporting file tools, but pinned ancestor/JIT memory discovery does not consult them despite documentation linking ignores to context.
An import begins with @ at content start or after whitespace, ends at whitespace, and its path begins with dot, slash, or an ASCII letter.
Relative imports resolve from the importing file and nested imports use the nested file directory as their base.
Canonical targets must stay within the nearest configured boundary root, or the importing file directory when no marker exists; URLs are rejected.
Documentation says marked detects code regions, while source uses matched backtick runs and does not recognize tilde fences.
Tree mode deduplicates within each import chain but can repeat a file across sibling branches; flat mode deduplicates globally and terminates cycles.
Tree mode defaults to depth 5; flat recursive processing does not enforce that limit, and no reviewed user setting exposes the documented configurable depth.
Tree mode emits an error comment for missing files; flat mode omits the target from its file list and only logs in debug despite general documentation promising an error comment.
/memory show renders static memory buckets, while its count includes JIT-loaded paths whose text was only injected into tool output.
/memory reload clears loaded identities, re-discovers static memory, emits a memory-changed event, and updates the initialized system instruction; refresh is an alias.
Context content edits require memory reload for guaranteed activation; ignore-file edits require CLI restart.
An isolated official package printed version 0.53.1 and help without authentication or a model request.
The reviewed help exposes no guaranteed local-only command for printing context discovery; interactive /memory testing was not started.

The 15 reviewed context, settings, ignore, import, and memory files are byte-identical between stable v0.53.1 and current f47d6c6; their SHA-256 digests are pinned without executing Gemini CLI or making a model request.
